summary.text: Charlie Geren is a Republican state representative from Texas House District 99 who has served since 2001 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election, where Democrat Michelle Winder is also on the ballot.

paragraphs.text: Charlie Geren is vice president and partner of Kelly, Geren and Searcy and president of Railhead Smokehouse, and he has worked as a deputy in the U.S. Marshal Service, according to Ballotpedia.
He is a member of groups including the Fort Worth Restaurant Association, the Fort Worth Zoo, the Rotary Club and the Texas Association of Realtors.
Geren assumed office in the Texas House in 2001.

He chaired the House Administration Committee in 2019-2020 and the Local & Consent Calendars Committee in 2021-2022, and for 2023-2024 was assigned to the Calendars, General Investigating and State Affairs committees.
